name: Kiwi 询报价工作台
description: 整理客户询盘、核对规格与 SKU、生成确定性报价草稿、比较新旧报价，并把待批准发布引导到可信管理页；导出与发送状态分开记录。
description_zh: 整理客户询盘、核对规格与 SKU、生成确定性报价草稿、比较新旧报价，并把待批准发布引导到可信管理页；导出与发送状态分开记录。
description_en: Structure customer inquiries, align specs and SKUs, produce deterministic quote drafts, compare quote revisions, and route pending releases to the trusted admin page; export and delivery states are recorded separately.
examples_zh: 客户这段话究竟要什么，还缺什么？帮我整理这份询盘
这几个规格对应哪个 SKU？列出候选和依据
按当前条件出一版报价
客户改了数量，重新报一版，并跟旧版比较差异
有哪些报价在等我批准？批准后我导出发给客户
examples_en: Structure this customer inquiry: what are they asking for and what is missing?
Which SKUs match these specs? Show candidates and evidence
Draft a quote under the current confirmed terms
The customer changed the quantity — re-quote and compare with the old version
Which quote releases are waiting for my approval?
